title: WHO: Doing What Matters in Times of Stress
text: World Health Organization practical stress guide covering grounding, difficult thoughts, values, and making room for difficult feelings.

title: NHS: Every Mind Matters
text: NHS guidance on managing stress, mental wellbeing, and finding support.

title: NIMH: Caring for Your Mental Health
text: National Institute of Mental Health guidance on mental well-being and self-care, including physical activity, regular meals, hydration, sleep, relaxation, setting priorities, gratitude, and staying connected with others.

title: CDC: Managing Stress
text: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention guidance about everyday stress, the effects of long-term stress, daily stress management, and seeking additional support when stress becomes difficult to manage.

title: WHO: Guideline on Self-Care Interventions for Health and Well-Being
text: World Health Organization guideline on self-care interventions as part of health and well-being. This is a broad guideline rather than a personalized treatment plan.
